note: The honest public-domain version of a 1990s horror shelf. The famous 90s horror films (Scream, I Know What You Did Last Summer, The Blair Witch Project, The Sixth Sense, Candyman and the rest) are under copyright and are NOT in this pack — they live in the owner's personal packs, not the public repo. What is real here: public-domain horror features from the 1920s-60s (silent nightmares, Universal-era chillers, drive-in creature features), each verified live against the Archive and Wikipedia's public-domain film list. Every item ID was live-checked on the Archive metadata API; the evidence for each film is listed in packs/BUILD-REPORT.md. A note in this file does not change the copyright status of anything in it.
